label: Share of soy protein in feed that is imported
label_vi: Tỷ lệ đạm đậu tương nhập khẩu trong thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: In 2025 Vietnam imported 2.61 Mt of soybeans (98.4% of imports plus domestic output) and 5.70 Mt of soybean meal; about 99% is our calculation. Domestic crushing uses imported beans, so it does not reduce protein import dependence.

label: Share of maize supply that is imported
label_vi: Tỷ lệ ngô nhập khẩu trong thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Vietnam imported 11.91 Mt of maize worth USD 2.95 billion in 2025, about 74% of total maize supply, mainly from Argentina and Brazil; domestic output was flat to falling at about 4.1 Mt.

label: Feed-ingredient import bill
label_vi: Kim ngạch nhập khẩu nguyên liệu thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Our sum of four 2025 customs lines: maize, soybeans, wheat and animal feed and ingredients. It is gross, includes some milling wheat and food soybeans, and is rounded to roughly USD 10 billion in summaries.

label: Livestock and poultry feed output
label_vi: Sản lượng thức ăn chăn nuôi gia súc, gia cầm
context: Industrial livestock and poultry feed, up from 21.5 Mt in 2024. It excludes aquafeed, for which 2025 estimates disagree: 3.9 to 4.8 Mt (industry: shrimp up to 0.92 Mt plus fish 3.0 to 3.9 Mt, our sum) against 6.5 Mt (USDA).

label: Seafood exports
label_vi: Kim ngạch xuất khẩu thủy sản
context: Seafood exports rose 12.4% in 2025 and included about USD 4.6 billion of shrimp and USD 2.2 billion of pangasius, much of it raised on imported feed protein.

label: World fishmeal price
label_vi: Giá bột cá thế giới
context: World Bank series for Peruvian fishmeal at 65% protein. August 2026 was 43% above a year earlier and the highest of 2020 to 2026; the 2025 average was USD 1,706 per t.

label: Pork output, live weight
label_vi: Sản lượng thịt lợn hơi
context: Pork output grew 3.9% on 2024, alongside 2.60 Mt of poultry meat (live weight) in 2025. Vietnam is one of Asia's largest producers of animal protein.

label: Livestock share of net national greenhouse-gas emissions
label_vi: Tỷ trọng của chăn nuôi trong tổng phát thải khí nhà kính ròng quốc gia
context: Enteric fermentation plus manure was 18.5 MtCO2e in the 2016 inventory, against 49.7 MtCO2e from rice. In our judgement, the environmental case rests more on imported feed, manure and antimicrobial use.

label: Cassava roots harvested
label_vi: Sản lượng sắn củ tươi
context: Fresh roots harvested from 499,100 ha in 2025, down 18,600 ha on 2024. Starch factories also process about 8 Mt a year of roots imported from Laos and Cambodia, about 42% of total root supply.

label: Cassava pulp from starch factories
label_vi: Lượng bã sắn từ các nhà máy tinh bột
context: Our 2025 estimate from Thai factory ratios and Vietnamese starch output: range 4 to 8 Mt wet, about 1.2 Mt dry matter. Pulp holds only 1.55% to 2.6% protein (dry basis), so it is a carbon source.

label: Cassava starch factories in Tay Ninh
label_vi: Số nhà máy chế biến tinh bột sắn tại Tây Ninh
context: Tay Ninh, which now includes former Long An, had 65 factories in 2025; before the merger, Tay Ninh had 68 and about 6.4 Mt a year of root capacity (2024). It is the largest cassava cluster and the natural site for pulp-based fermentation.

label: Rice bran produced
label_vi: Sản lượng cám gạo
context: Our estimate at 10% of 43.5 Mt of paddy in 2025. Bran is traded, not free: about 1.2 Mt was exported in 2025, and much of the rest goes into domestic feed.

label: Brewer's spent grain, upper bound
label_vi: Lượng bã bia phát sinh tối đa mỗi năm
context: Derived from beer output or consumption of 4 to 4.4 billion litres a year (2019 to 2022 reports). At about 20% dry matter and 20% protein (dry basis), it holds only about 32 to 35 kt of protein, and it spoils within two to three days.

label: Rise in fresh cassava root prices in a year
label_vi: Mức tăng giá sắn củ tươi sau một năm
context: Fresh roots at 30% starch reached VND 3,000 to 3,550 per kg in April 2026, about 75% above April 2025, after a supply shortfall. The E10 fuel-ethanol mandate, in force from June 2026, adds a new buyer.

label: Installed aerobic fermentation volume
label_vi: Tổng thể tích bồn lên men hiếu khí đã lắp đặt
context: Our modelled 2026 estimate from published and assumed plant capacities for sterile, aerated tanks (Vedan's current capacity assumed; see fermentation_volume_estimate.csv). Almost all of it sits inside Vedan, Ajinomoto and Daesang, and we found no published offer of contract fermentation.

label: Industrial feed mills and their utilisation
label_vi: Số nhà máy thức ăn chăn nuôi và mức khai thác công suất
context: In 2023, 269 mills had 43.2 Mt a year of design capacity; they produced 20.8 Mt in 2022, about 48% utilisation. Spare capacity makes feed trials easy to host.

label: Share of shrimp feed made by six firms
label_vi: Thị phần thức ăn tôm của sáu doanh nghiệp dẫn đầu
context: In 2025 Sheng Long, C.P., Uni-President, Tongwei, Grobest and Gromax supplied about 640 kt of shrimp feed, at least about 70% of a market of up to 920 kt (our calculation), so a new feed protein has about six real buyers in shrimp.

label: Soybean crushing capacity of the VAL plant
label_vi: Công suất ép đậu tương của nhà máy VAL
context: Bunge and Wilmar's plant at Phu My, Ho Chi Minh City, after a USD 100 million second line in December 2025, probably design capacity. It crushes mainly imported beans into oil and about 2 Mt of meal for the feed industry.

label: Median protein in audited plant-based foods
label_vi: Hàm lượng đạm trung vị của sản phẩm chay được khảo sát
context: Across 43 ready-to-eat or ready-to-cook products with a label value in our September 2026 audit of 11 stores; 53% had under 5 g and only 16% reached 10 g.

label: Audited products relying on imported protein
label_vi: Tỷ lệ sản phẩm được khảo sát dùng đạm nhập khẩu
context: Of 170 products in our September 2026 audit whose main protein ingredient could be identified, 77% rely on an imported one and 11% partly do. Soybeans count as imported.

label: China's exports of textured protein to Vietnam
label_vi: Lượng đạm tạo cấu trúc Trung Quốc xuất sang Việt Nam
context: China-reported 2023 exports under HS 2106.10 (protein concentrates and textured protein) at about USD 1.6 per kg (2023; USD 1.24 per kg FOB in 2025, about USD 1.29 to 1.38 landed duty-free), plus 10,028 t of HS 3504 and 10,338 t of gluten.

label: Vinasoy's share of the soy-milk market
label_vi: Thị phần sữa đậu nành của Vinasoy
context: Company or press-reported, not audited. Vinasoy had more than VND 4,100 billion of soy-milk revenue in 2024 and 390 million litres a year of capacity (2025), on imported soybeans.

label: Entobel insect-meal design capacity
label_vi: Công suất thiết kế bột côn trùng của Entobel
context: Black soldier fly meal from a 1,000 t plant in Dong Nai (2019) and a 10,000 t plant in Ho Chi Minh City (2023). Output is not disclosed; insects are a benchmark here, not a play.

label: Vinh Hoan offtake of Entobel insect protein
label_vi: Cam kết bao tiêu đạm côn trùng Entobel của Vĩnh Hoàn
context: Announced in February 2024 by the pangasius exporter: about 5,000 t a year, roughly 45% of Entobel's 11,000 t a year design capacity in Vietnam.

label: Food Safety Law: first reading and vote
label_vi: Luật An toàn thực phẩm sửa đổi: cho ý kiến lần đầu và thông qua
context: The National Assembly Standing Committee agreed on 24 September 2026 to take first comments at the October 2026 session and to consider passage at the May 2027 session, so a new-food clause needs to be in the draft revised between the two sessions, in practice by early 2027. The draft was notified to the WTO in August 2026.

label: Agency time for a new feed-material trial
label_vi: Thời gian xử lý hồ sơ khảo nghiệm thức ăn chăn nuôi mới
context: Protocol approval and result recognition take 15 plus 5 working days each (Circular 94/2025). The trial and listing of the material come on top; 6 to 18 months in total is our estimate.

label: Fine for using an unlisted feed raw material
label_vi: Mức phạt khi dùng nguyên liệu ngoài danh mục thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Under Decree 211/2026, in force since 5 August 2026, plus one to three months' suspension of feed production and repurposing or, failing that, destruction of the material. The suspension costs more than the fine.

label: Corporate income tax rate for high-tech projects
label_vi: Thuế suất thu nhập doanh nghiệp ưu đãi cho dự án công nghệ cao
context: Under Law 67/2025, in force from 1 October 2025, high-tech enterprises and projects applying listed high technology also get four years' exemption and nine years at 50%.

label: Novel-food research intensity relative to Thailand
label_vi: Cường độ nghiên cứu thực phẩm mới so với Thái Lan
value: about a quarter to a third of Thailand's
context: Plant-based or cultivated meat records per 10,000 publications, 2015 to September 2026: Vietnam 0.37 against Thailand 1.58 on OpenAIRE, about 24% (our calculation). Version 0.2 adds OpenAlex (queried 24 Sep 2026): 4.1 against 13.4 core-basket works per 10,000 national publications, 2015 to 2025, about 31%. Counts are lower bounds.

label: Can Tho University places in three core programmes
label_vi: Chỉ tiêu tuyển sinh ba ngành cốt lõi tại Đại học Cần Thơ
context: Places in food technology (300), biotechnology (240) and aquaculture (320) in 2026, within a total quota of 11,850. We could not build a national intake figure.

label: Entobel insect-meal project financing
label_vi: Tổng vốn dự án bột côn trùng Entobel
context: Mekong Capital USD 25 million and Dragon Capital USD 5 million (2022), plus an IFC USD 2.5 million upstream agreement (2023). Earlier drafts said USD 36 million, which is not supported.

label: Venture capital invested in Vietnam
label_vi: Vốn đầu tư mạo hiểm vào Việt Nam
context: Raised across 103 deals in 2025; definitions differ between reports. With no VC- or PE-backed technology IPO in 2025 or the four years before, exits must come through sales to other investors or firms (our inference).

label: Agriculture venture capital in Vietnam
label_vi: Vốn đầu tư mạo hiểm vào nông nghiệp tại Việt Nam
context: About 0.2% of the USD 509 million of venture capital raised in Vietnam in 2025. We found no disclosed institutional venture round for a Vietnam-based plant-based or fermentation company.

label: Global alternative-protein investment
label_vi: Vốn đầu tư toàn cầu vào protein thay thế
context: Plant-based USD 450 million, fermentation 357 million and cultivated 74 million in 2025, a cyclical low. Money is shifting towards fermentation and upstream ingredients.

label: Vietnam's regional score on regulatory readiness
label_vi: Điểm sẵn sàng pháp lý của Việt Nam trong khu vực
context: From the October 2025 GFI APAC and Hawkwood Biotech study of nine Asia-Pacific countries. Vietnam scores 100 on labour cost but has no novel-food framework and no approvals.

label: Novel foods approved by Singapore
label_vi: Số thực phẩm mới được Singapore phê duyệt
context: Singapore Food Agency list of 14 August 2026: 6 cultivated meats, 6 fungal or bacterial biomass proteins, 3 precision-fermented ingredients, 2 microalgae and 1 synthetic compound.

label: Cassava starch exports
label_vi: Xuất khẩu tinh bột sắn
context: In 2023, 93.5% went to China. China bought only USD 0.16 million of glucose syrup from Vietnam in 2024, suggesting the starch-to-sugar step that feeds fermentation mostly happens after the starch leaves Vietnam.

label: Food protein ingredient imports
label_vi: Kim ngạch nhập khẩu nguyên liệu đạm thực phẩm
context: Our sum of Vietnam-reported 2023 imports under HS 3504 (USD 22.2 million) and HS 2106.10 (USD 34.0 million). Small next to feed protein imports, and some of it is feed-grade.
version_note: Id changed in v0.6 (was a duplicate of kn-protein-ingredient-imports)

label: Labour share of fermentation production cost
label_vi: Tỷ trọng chi phí nhân công trong giá thành lên men
context: In the 2025 regional study's plant models, labour is 5% (biomass) and 4% (precision fermentation) of cost; utilities are 7% and 17%. The models are for a US Midwest plant, not an Asian site.

label: Blended power price for a 24/7 plant
label_vi: Giá điện bình quân cho nhà máy chạy liên tục
context: Our calculation for a 22 kV connection from the tariff in force since May 2025 and the April 2026 peak hours, about USD 0.075. It excludes VAT and any future capacity charge.

label: Monthly minimum wage, Region I
label_vi: Lương tối thiểu vùng I theo tháng
context: From 1 January 2026 under Decree 293/2025, about USD 204. Earlier drafts used the 2024 to 2025 level of VND 4,960,000. Labour is a small share of fermentation cost.

label: Grid emission factor
label_vi: Hệ số phát thải của lưới điện
context: Latest official factor (2023); no official 2024 or 2025 factor had been published as of January 2026, and we found none in our September 2026 search. Power-intensive processes carry a high carbon footprint without renewable supply.

label: Indicative cost of fungal feed protein in Vietnam
label_vi: Giá thành ước tính của đạm nấm cho thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: Our indicative 2026 cost stack for a 10,000 t a year plant, not a feasibility study. Capital charges and maintenance are 54% to 67% of cost; fishmeal protein costs USD 2,625 to 3,846.

label: Fishmeal price per tonne of protein
label_vi: Giá bột cá quy ra mỗi tấn đạm
context: Our calculation at 65% protein from the World Bank series: 2025 average (USD 1,706 per t) and August 2026 (USD 2,500 per t). Soybean meal protein was about USD 800 to 880 per t (2025 to Aug 2026, at 46% protein).

label: Indicative cost of textured soy protein
label_vi: Giá thành ước tính của đạm đậu nành tạo cấu trúc
value: about 3,800 to 7,900 VND per 100 g protein
context: Our indicative 2026 full cost of domestic dry textured soy (USD 0.76 to 1.57 per kg) for 0.5 and 1 t per hour lines on imported soy flour priced from trade unit values (low case assumes feed-grade meal prices), at 50 to 90% utilisation. Flour is 63 to 85% of cost; Chinese product lands at about USD 1.29 to 1.38 per kg at the 0% duty that applies, so the delivered flour price decides whether a line pays.

label: Retail price of egg and chicken protein
label_vi: Giá bán lẻ đạm từ trứng và thịt gà
value: about 34,000 to 45,000 VND per 100 g protein
context: Online grocery prices in Ho Chi Minh City on 24 September 2026, on food-table protein contents (our calculation). Eggs and chicken set the floor for mass-market plant-based products; lean pork is about 70,900 VND.

label: Extra cooling cost for fermentation in the tropics
label_vi: Chi phí làm lạnh tăng thêm khi lên men ở vùng nhiệt đới
value: USD 70 to 180 per t dry biomass
context: Our indicative 2026 estimate for southern Vietnam, where we assume cooling water arrives at 31 to 33 °C. It adds about 2% to 4% to fungal feed protein cost; thermotolerant strains avoid most of it.

label: Best published leghemoglobin titer vs bulk benchmark
label_vi: Nồng độ leghemoglobin cao nhất đã công bố so với ngưỡng cần đạt
context: The best published leghemoglobin titers (2022 to 2026) are 3.5, 7.27 and 10.1 g/L, about 5 to 14 times below the 50 g/L a leading review says bulk proteins need. That benchmark is an expert assertion.

label: Gas-fermentation protein in whiteleg shrimp diets without growth loss
label_vi: Tỷ lệ đạm lên men khí trong khẩu phần tôm thẻ chân trắng mà không làm giảm tăng trưởng
context: In a digestibility trial (2022 to 2023), bacterial protein from steel-mill off-gas made up 30% of the diet without growth loss. Replacing 50% of fishmeal cut growth unless 0.06% bile acid (CDCA) was added.

label: Protein quality score (DIAAS) of cooked mung bean
label_vi: Điểm chất lượng đạm DIAAS của đậu xanh nấu chín
context: Measured in pigs on the older child and adult pattern (2020 study). Human digestibility of mung bean in children was about 20% lower. We found no Vietnamese DIAAS study.

label: Cultivated meat cost relative to retail meat
label_vi: Giá thành thịt nuôi cấy so với giá thịt bán lẻ
context: Our calculation: a modelled USD 37 to 51 per kg of wet cells against Vietnamese retail prices of lean pork and chicken breast in September 2026. There is no near-term production case.

label: Plays and public goods assessed
label_vi: Số hướng đi kinh doanh và hàng hóa công được đánh giá
context: Our count from plays.csv (September 2026): ten businesses or programmes, each with conditions, kill tests, first customers and a horizon, plus six public goods that lower the cost of all of them.

label: Leading plays under balanced weights
label_vi: Các hướng đi dẫn đầu theo bộ trọng số cân bằng
context: The cassava-starch-to-sugar hub (T4) and domestic textured plant protein (T1) lead under balanced weights in 2026; T2 and T5 follow at 3.45. Scores are our judgement, not an investment rating.

label: Policy options in the register
label_vi: Số phương án chính sách trong danh mục
context: Our count from policy_options.csv (September 2026): 33 options, of which chapter 27 ranks 24; the other nine earlier options are kept but superseded by more specific ones.

label: Ranked policy options needing low effort
label_vi: Số phương án chính sách đã xếp hạng, dễ triển khai
context: Derived from policy_options.csv: ranked options rated Low effort (a letter, guidance or list update), as of September 2026. The report text does not state this total; ranks 1 to 4 are all low effort.

label: Industrial feed output target for 2030
label_vi: Mục tiêu sản lượng thức ăn chăn nuôi công nghiệp năm 2030
context: Set by the livestock strategy (Decision 1520/2020), against about 22 Mt of livestock and poultry feed in 2025. The feed scheme (Decision 1625/QD-TTg, 2023) indicates that the target covers livestock feed only (Medium confidence); see kn-feed-target-livestock-2030 for the comparison with our model.

label: Projected population of Vietnam
label_vi: Dân số Việt Nam dự báo
context: UN medium variant. Population grows only about 5% between 2025 and 2035 and peaks around 2049, so protein demand growth will come mostly from income and diet.

label: Fishmeal to soybean meal price ratio
label_vi: Tỷ lệ giá bột cá so với khô đậu tương
context: From World Bank prices: USD 2,500 against USD 403 per t in August 2026. A ratio sustained above about 5 supports fishmeal replacers; one month's price may revert.

label: Open questions in the register
label_vi: Số câu hỏi còn bỏ ngỏ
context: Our count from open_questions.csv (v0.7, September 2026), including 28 added by the futures round, 114 by the demand round, 107 by the actor check and expansion waves 7 to 9 and 70 by the v0.7 citation check. Each question records why it matters, the cheapest way to close it and who to ask; chapter 30 ranks the twenty supply-side questions that matter most.

label: Recorded disagreements between sources
label_vi: Số điểm bất nhất giữa các nguồn
context: Our count from disagreements.csv (v0.4, September 2026), including 28 added by the futures round, 89 by the demand round and 93 by the actor check and expansion waves 7 to 9. Each entry gives both claims and the position we took; we never average disagreeing numbers.

label: Sources logged
label_vi: Số nguồn tài liệu đã ghi nhận
context: Our count from sources.csv: 599 sources from wave 1 and 207 from wave 2 (v0.1), 469 from the futures round (waves 3 to 5, v0.2), 451 from the demand round (wave 6, v0.3), 577 from the actor check and expansion waves 7 to 9 (v0.4) and 81 from the prologue research (wave 10, v0.5), including press, peer-reviewed papers, company pages, statistics and legal texts.

label: Provincial-level units after the 2025 reform
label_vi: Số đơn vị hành chính cấp tỉnh sau sắp xếp năm 2025
context: From 1 July 2025, 28 provinces and 6 centrally governed cities replaced 63 units, and the district tier was abolished. The report uses the new names throughout.

label: Peak working-age population
label_vi: Dân số trong độ tuổi lao động đạt đỉnh
context: People aged 65 and over rise from 9.5% (2025) to 20.0% (2050) of the population; the old-age dependency ratio rises from 14 to 32 per 100. UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant.

label: Agricultural emissions cap, 2050
label_vi: Mức trần phát thải nông nghiệp năm 2050
context: Official cap: 64 MtCO2e in 2030 and 56 MtCO2e in 2050, against a 2020 base of 104.5 MtCO2e, the NDC business-as-usual level (46% lower, our calculation). Official livestock levers are feed rations, manure and biogas, not alternative protein.

label: Mekong Delta subsidence from groundwater pumping
label_vi: Tốc độ sụt lún do khai thác nước ngầm ở ĐBSCL
context: About three times the current rate of global sea-level rise (IPCC AR6: 3.7 mm a year, 2006 to 2018); the delta sits on average about 0.8 m above sea level. Subsidence to 2100 ranges from 12 to 100 cm depending on extraction policy.

label: Chance of a joint maize failure in the four largest exporters
label_vi: Xác suất bốn nước xuất khẩu ngô lớn nhất cùng mất mùa
context: Probability that all four largest maize exporters (87% of world exports) lose more than 10% in the same year: near zero today, 7% at 2 °C of warming (possible from the 2040s, median mid-2050s under high emissions), 86% at 4 °C. Vietnam imports about three-quarters of its maize.

label: Protein from power made in Vietnam, 2050
label_vi: Giá thành đạm từ điện sản xuất tại Việt Nam năm 2050
value: USD 3.3 to 6.5 per kg of protein
context: Our estimate for hydrogen-route protein made in Vietnam: USD 6.9 to 12.6 per kg (2030), 4.7 to 8.6 (2040), 3.3 to 6.5 (2050), against fishmeal protein at 2.6 to 3.8 and soybean-meal protein at about 0.88 per kg (2025 to 2026 prices).

label: Cost fall per doubling in fermentation industries
label_vi: Mức giảm chi phí mỗi lần sản lượng tăng gấp đôi trong ngành lên men
context: US corn ethanol 13% (1983 to 2005); Brazilian cane ethanol 19 to 20% (1975 to 2005). We found no observed learning rate for any alternative protein (OpenAlex search, 2026).

label: Cost floor for fungal feed protein on cassava glucose
label_vi: Mức giá sàn của đạm nấm làm thức ăn chăn nuôi từ glucose sắn
value: about USD 1,870 per t of protein, 2.1 times soybean-meal protein
context: Low-cost case, excluding capital and maintenance (high case about USD 4,900). Glucose and urea set most of this floor, so learning alone cannot close the gap to soybean-meal protein (USD 880 per t). Our calculation (working-papers/wave3/econ_policy/ecf_calc.py) on the chapter 9 cost stack.

label: Power needed for 1 Mt of protein from power a year
label_vi: Điện năng cần cho 1 triệu tấn đạm từ điện mỗi năm
value: 64 to 83 TWh (4 to 6% of planned 2050 supply)
context: Also 43 to 56 GW of solar or 14 to 22 GW of offshore wind, 0.69 Mt of hydrogen (3.5 to 6.9% of the 2050 hydrogen target) and 2.95 Mt of CO2. Our calculation from a published model and Vietnam's power and hydrogen plans.

label: Vietnamese share of gas-fermentation protein research
label_vi: Số công trình của Việt Nam về đạm lên men khí
context: OpenAlex, queried 24 Sep 2026: publications on gas- or CO2-based microbial protein, 2016 to 2026: China 105, US 64, Denmark 47, Vietnam 2.

label: Soybean-meal need in 2050 on trend
label_vi: Nhu cầu khô đậu tương năm 2050 theo xu hướng
context: Our balance model on trend diets and trend efficiency: 7.2 Mt (2025), 8.5 (2030), 10.0 (2040), 10.4 (2050), nearly all imported. Published projections stop at 2035.

label: Soybean-meal need in 2050 across four scenarios
label_vi: Khoảng nhu cầu khô đậu tương năm 2050 theo bốn kịch bản
context: S-EFF 7.0, S-ALT 8.8, S-BASE 10.4, S-HIGH 11.7 Mt. Only the efficiency scenario keeps soybean-meal import need (meal plus crushed beans) at or below the 2025 level of 7.2 Mt. Our estimate from the balance model (app-f4-balance-model); QNT-01 is used only for calibration to 2035.

label: Farmland abroad used for Vietnam's imported feed
label_vi: Diện tích đất ở nước ngoài phục vụ thức ăn chăn nuôi nhập khẩu của Việt Nam
value: about 4.0 million ha (2025); 4.7 million ha (2050, trend)
context: Imported soybean meal needs about 2.3 million ha (mass allocation) and imported maize 1.6 million ha: together about five times Vietnam's own maize area. Our calculation.

label: Efficiency against alternative protein, 2050
label_vi: Hiệu quả thức ăn so với đạm thay thế, năm 2050
value: 3.4 Mt against 1.6 Mt of soybean meal saved
context: Against trend, feed conversion improving 1.0% a year (livestock) and 0.8% (aquaculture) instead of 0.4% and 0.3%, and soybean-meal inclusion falling 1% a year, save 3.4 Mt in 2050; replacing 10% of soybean-meal protein, 40% of fishmeal protein and 10% of meat demand with alternatives saves 1.6 Mt. The two act through different channels (combined case not modelled). Our estimate from the balance model (tools/balance_model.py, app-f4-balance-model); QNT-01 is used only for 2025 to 2035 calibration.

label: Scale implied by the alternative-protein scenario, 2050
label_vi: Quy mô cần có theo kịch bản đạm thay thế năm 2050
context: S-ALT implies about 0.86 Mt of dry microbial feed product in 2050: about 78 times the combined design capacity of Entobel's two Vietnamese insect-meal plants (11 kt a year), or 43 plants of Calysseo's 20 kt size; about 9 times by 2030. Plus 0.29 Mt of food protein ingredient. Our arithmetic.

label: Aquafeed omega-3 need, 2050
label_vi: Nhu cầu omega-3 trong thức ăn thủy sản năm 2050
value: about 21 kt of EPA plus DHA (10 to 40 kt)
context: About 11 kt today. Pangasius oil holds only 0.17 to 0.31% EPA plus DHA in its fatty acids (Indonesian study), so the need must be imported or made. Our estimate.

label: The 2030 industrial feed target covers livestock only
label_vi: Mục tiêu thức ăn công nghiệp năm 2030 chỉ tính thức ăn chăn nuôi
value: 30 to 32 Mt target against 26.4 Mt modelled
context: Decision 1625/QD-TTg sets 24 to 25 Mt of industrial livestock feed for 2025 (probably missed: about 21.5 Mt in 2024) and 30 to 32 Mt for 2030. Our model gives 26.4 Mt of livestock and poultry feed in 2030. Answers OQ-127 at Medium confidence.

label: Peruvian anchoveta, first season 2026
label_vi: Vụ cá cơm Peru đầu năm 2026
value: about 25% of a 1.9 Mt quota landed
context: The lowest quota in a decade, 36% below 2025; world fishmeal output fell 26% year on year in January to April 2026. NOAA gives over 90% odds of a very strong El Nino in winter 2026 to 2027.

label: Plays that thrive in all four 2050 worlds
label_vi: Số hướng đi thành công trong cả bốn kịch bản 2050
context: Public feed-trial capacity, a protein-quality laboratory and an open cost model and price series. Ten more plays hold in every world with conditions; two are bets; one is a research option. Our judgement.

label: Vision: soybean-meal need in 2050
label_vi: Tầm nhìn: nhu cầu khô đậu tương năm 2050
value: 7 to 9 Mt, against 10.4 Mt on trend
context: Normative goal, not a forecast: a credible ambitious range based on the balance model's efficiency and alternative-protein scenarios (app-f4-balance-model) and on China's and Norway's achieved pace. Holding need at the 2025 level of 7.2 Mt is a stretch.

label: Vision: microbial protein in feed, 2050
label_vi: Tầm nhìn: tỷ lệ đạm vi sinh trong thức ăn năm 2050
context: Normative goal: about 1% by 2030, 1 to 3% by 2035, 2 to 4% by 2040. No feed sector we found has reached 1%; Norwegian salmon feed, the best documented, used 0.4% novel ingredients by mass in 2020. The top of the range is a stretch.

label: Vision: non-marine omega-3 in aquafeed, 2050
label_vi: Tầm nhìn: omega-3 không từ biển trong thức ăn thủy sản năm 2050
context: Normative goal based on commercial algal and oilseed omega-3 oils; in one trial, omega-3 canola oil replaced all fish oil in low-fishmeal shrimp diets without growth loss.

label: Furthest horizon of any national protein plan
label_vi: Tầm xa nhất của các kế hoạch quốc gia về đạm
context: EU, Canada and Singapore stop at 2035; Japan at FY2030; China, Israel and the Netherlands at 2030. Japan's MIDORI (2050) and Denmark's land deal (2045) carry no protein indicator. One exception: a Japanese food-tech investment roadmap to 2040, reported only in the press (Low confidence).

label: No-regret moves for 2026 to 2030
label_vi: Số biện pháp không hối tiếc cho giai đoạn 2026 đến 2030
context: A protein and feed balance; feed efficiency and formulation; new-food and new-feed routes with deadlines; shared pilot and trial capacity; a quality laboratory and price series; residue-carbon rules; an omega-3 plan; climate-proof siting; process skills. Our judgement.

label: Value of cheaper capital for fermentation protein
label_vi: Giá trị của vốn rẻ hơn đối với đạm lên men
value: 12% to 9% capital charge does as much as the learning expected by 2030
unit: USD per t protein (2030 low end)
context: Cutting the annual capital charge from 12% to 9% lowers the 2030 low-end cost of fungal feed protein to about USD 3,610 per t of protein with no learning at all, close to the central learning case in 2030 (USD 3,557 after two doublings of output). Our calculation (ecf_calc.py) on the chapter 9 cost stack.

label: Meat eaten per person per day (2020)
label_vi: Lượng thịt tiêu thụ bình quân mỗi người mỗi ngày (2020)
context: National General Nutrition Survey 2019 to 2020; urban residents 155.3 g; 84 g in 2010. The national recommendation is 50 to 80 g a day.

label: Share of protein supply from animal foods (2023)
label_vi: Tỷ trọng đạm từ thực phẩm động vật trong nguồn cung đạm (2023)
context: 43.2 of 102.2 g of protein per person per day (FAO food balance sheets); 21% in 1990 and 28% in 2000 (older FAO series). Richer neighbours (Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Malaysia) sit at 55 to 60%; China and Thailand are near 40%.

label: Rise in meat eaten per person, 2025 to 2035 (projection)
label_vi: Mức tăng tiêu thụ thịt bình quân đầu người, 2025 đến 2035 (dự báo)
context: OECD-FAO baseline: 49.8 to 62.2 kg per person (retail weight); poultry from 17.0 to 25.8 kg. With population growth, about 1.56 Mt more meat a year by 2035 (our calculation).

label: Retail price of protein from eggs and chicken
label_vi: Giá bán lẻ đạm từ trứng và thịt gà
value: VND 34,000 to 45,000 per 100 g of protein
context: Hen eggs 34,300; chicken thigh 39,000; chicken breast 44,800. Lean pork about 70,900; tofu about 30,000 (food-table basis; 35,000 to 86,000 on label protein); beef about 119,000 to 143,000. Bach Hoa Xanh and WinMart online, 24 September 2026.

label: Price of imported plant-based analogues against eggs and chicken, per gram of protein
label_vi: Giá thịt thực vật nhập khẩu so với trứng và thịt gà, tính theo gam đạm
context: VND 542,000 to 622,000 per 100 g of protein on shelf, against VND 34,000 to 45,000 for eggs and chicken. The meat-analogue premiums that coincided with stalling demand in the US and Germany were about 45 to 77% per kg.

label: Children under five who are stunted (2023)
label_vi: Tỷ lệ trẻ dưới 5 tuổi thấp còi (2023)
context: 32% among ethnic minority children (reported 2024; UNICEF 2027 to 2031 country programme); 19.6% in 2020 and 29.3% in 2010. UNICEF and the World Bank focus prevention on the first 1,000 days of life.

label: Meat protein already avoided by chay days (estimate)
label_vi: Lượng đạm thịt đã được thay thế nhờ các ngày ăn chay (ước tính)
value: about 25,000 t a year (about 2.5% of meat protein)
context: Assumes 30% of people keep 2.5 chay days a month (illustrative range 1.3 to 6.7% of person-days; a 2021 national diet survey found 7.9% of adults ate no meat, poultry or fish on the previous day, which makes about 5% the practical upper bound). Same order as the Part IV S-ALT assumption for 2030 to 2035, but already in the meat baseline. Our calculation.

label: Chay sales in the seventh lunar month against normal
label_vi: Doanh số đồ chay trong tháng bảy âm lịch so với ngày thường
value: 2 to 3 times in specialist channels; +20 to 40% in mainstream retail
context: Synthesis of seller and retailer reports, 2024 to 2026, Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City; one Ho Chi Minh City tofu shop raised output 15 to 20% with prices steady; fresh mushroom prices roughly double.

label: Chay restaurant listings on Foody
label_vi: Số địa điểm ăn chay trên Foody
context: 23 former provinces; 1,873 in Ho Chi Minh City, 401 in Hanoi, 201 in Da Nang. Cumulative and including closed venues. The largest chain we could count has 14 outlets.

label: Branded soy milk sales (2025, derivation)
label_vi: Doanh thu sữa đậu nành có thương hiệu (2025, ước tính)
context: Vinasoy soy-milk revenue of about VND 4,800 billion divided by its 90.6% share of branded soy milk (2024). The only modern plant category with traceable scale in Vietnam.

label: Urban online respondents who intend to eat less meat
label_vi: Tỷ lệ người được khảo sát trực tuyến ở đô thị dự định giảm ăn thịt
context: GFI APAC survey, online panel in the Hanoi region and Ho Chi Minh City (n = 1,049); lowest of six Southeast Asian countries (average 21%). Respondents report 43.3 meat-eating occasions a month.

label: Urban online respondents who eat plant-based meat weekly
label_vi: Tỷ lệ người được khảo sát ăn thịt thực vật hằng tuần
context: 90% have heard of plant-based meat, 42% have tried it, 20% eat it monthly. Much of this is probably traditional mock meat. Same survey as above.

label: Would choose plant-based meat over meat, by relative price
label_vi: Tỷ lệ chọn thịt thực vật thay vì thịt, theo mức giá tương đối
context: Stated choice in an online survey; GFI says it shows relative interest, not willingness to pay. Vietnam highest of six countries at parity.

label: Search interest in nut milk against plant meat
label_vi: Mức quan tâm tìm kiếm sữa hạt so với thịt thực vật
context: Google Trends, Vietnam: sữa hạt against thịt thực vật, average 2019 to September 2026. Nut milk has tripled since 2019; plant meat peaked in 2021 to 2022 and fell about 60%.

label: Cost of 20 g of protein from a chay wrapper against a street meal
label_vi: Chi phí cho 20 g đạm từ đồ chay cuốn so với một suất cơm bình dân
value: about VND 74,000 against VND 29,000 to 35,000 for a meal
context: Median of filled chay wrappers in the retail audit, on label protein (our calculation). Tofu or dried textured soy about VND 13,000; frozen analogue about VND 56,000; eggs or chicken VND 7,000 to 9,000.

label: US plant-based meat retail sales, 2021 to 2025
label_vi: Doanh số bán lẻ thịt thực vật tại Mỹ, 2021 đến 2025
context: Share of total meat sales halved from 1.4% to about 0.7%; households buying fell from about 20% to 11% while the repeat rate stayed near 60%.

label: Plant-based meat share of pre-packaged meat volume
label_vi: Tỷ trọng thịt thực vật trong khối lượng thịt đóng gói bán ra
context: Germany 3.1%, Netherlands 4.1% (4.6% in 2022). Households buying 12 or more times a year: UK 8.6%, Germany 9.7%.

label: Premium paid for soymilk labelled non-GM (auction)
label_vi: Mức giá sẵn lòng trả thêm cho sữa đậu nành không biến đổi gen (đấu giá thực nghiệm)
context: Experimental auction in Vietnam. Our reading: precision-fermented proteins probably count as products of a GMO under Decree 43/2026, and their likely buyers market non-GMO.

label: Cultivated chicken servings sold in Singapore, December 2020 to May 2024
label_vi: Số suất thịt gà nuôi cấy bán tại Singapore, 12/2020 đến 5/2024
context: Company claim. Another firm reported more than 25,000 dishes from April 2024 to August 2025. In November 2025 Singapore's food agency cited weaker-than-expected acceptance.

label: Preferred animal share in blended meat (blind test)
label_vi: Tỷ lệ thịt động vật được ưa thích trong sản phẩm thịt pha trộn (thử mù)
context: Singapore blind test of 20 blends (n=116); 57% of tasters preferred about 75% animal meat; blends 1.8 times as likely as plant-based meat to be liked; a chicken mince with 30 to 50% plant protein beat 100% chicken.

label: Vissan meat formulations listing soy protein
label_vi: Tỷ lệ công thức sản phẩm thịt của Vissan có đạm đậu nành
context: Online label audit of 118 products (91 with a published list); 33% of 67 unique meat formulations list soy protein and 37% list at least one added protein (soy, wheat, milk or egg white), mostly in value lines. Vietnam already eats low-inclusion blends.

label: Share of food retail through traditional channels (2024)
label_vi: Tỷ trọng bán lẻ thực phẩm qua kênh truyền thống (2024)
context: Of USD 55.5 billion food retail sales. Supermarkets 9%, hypermarkets 3%, convenience 1%, food e-commerce about 1%. About 80% of fresh meat is sold through traditional channels.

label: Stores of the two largest grocery chains (2026)
label_vi: Số cửa hàng của hai chuỗi bán lẻ thực phẩm lớn nhất (2026)
context: Bach Hoa Xanh 3,612 (end of August 2026) and WinCommerce 5,141 (mid-2026), each opening 1,000 or more stores a year, with a push into rural areas.

label: Factory canteen meals a year (upper bound)
label_vi: Số suất ăn ca tại khu công nghiệp mỗi năm (mức trần)
context: 4.15 million industrial-park workers x about 300 meal days; meals cost VND 20,000 to 35,000; food is 60 to 80% of the price. Our calculation.

label: Budget for the protein dish of a canteen meal
label_vi: Ngân sách cho món đạm trong một suất ăn ca
context: Assumes the protein dish takes about half of the meal's food budget (our assumption). 20 g of protein costs VND 6,900 to 9,000 from eggs or chicken, VND 22,400 from a branded retail analogue and VND 740 to 2,140 from textured protein at indicative ex-factory cost. Our calculation.

label: Protein-ingredient imports (2023)
label_vi: Kim ngạch nhập khẩu nguyên liệu đạm (2023)
context: 13 customs lines; plant proteins USD 87 million, dairy proteins USD 119 million, gelatin USD 62 million, egg proteins USD 16 million. Includes some feed-grade and supplement products.

label: Plant proteins shipped from China to Vietnam, 2019 to 2025
label_vi: Khối lượng đạm thực vật Trung Quốc xuất sang Việt Nam, 2019 đến 2025
context: China-reported HS 3504, 2106.10 and 1109; USD 59.7 million in 2025. Part of the 2024 jump is probably feed-grade (not verified).

label: Border price of commodity plant proteins, per kg of protein
label_vi: Giá biên giới của đạm thực vật thông dụng, tính trên mỗi kg đạm
context: Chinese gluten, textured protein and soy isolate. Egg, dairy and Western pea proteins cost USD 7 to 18 per kg of protein (mostly 7 to 11).

label: Vietnam's exports of textured protein and protein concentrates (2023)
label_vi: Kim ngạch xuất khẩu đạm tạo cấu trúc và đạm cô đặc của Việt Nam (2023)
context: HS 2106.10. Imports of the same code were about USD 34 million; China exported USD 380 million in 2024.

label: EU tariff on textured protein: Vietnam against most countries
label_vi: Thuế nhập khẩu EU với đạm tạo cấu trúc: Việt Nam so với đa số nước
context: EU and Vietnam free trade agreement; Thai and Chinese goods pay 12.8%. Similar zero rates for food preparations, plant drinks and prepared nuts, and in the UK and (for textured vegetable protein) Japan.

label: Extra US tariff on Vietnamese goods from 24 July 2026
label_vi: Thuế bổ sung của Mỹ với hàng Việt Nam từ 24/7/2026
context: Section 301 action; 10% for Malaysia, Indonesia and India; cashews and coconuts exempt, prepared plant-based foods not.

label: Kearney 2019 forecast against actual, plant-based meat share of meat in 2025
label_vi: Dự báo của Kearney năm 2019 so với thực tế: tỷ trọng thịt thực vật trong thị trường thịt năm 2025
context: USD 6.6 billion global retail sales against a forecast of about USD 120 billion. Forecasts made at the 2019 to 2021 peak overshot by one to two orders of magnitude.

label: Benchmark path, 2035: protein delivered and meat protein displaced
label_vi: Kịch bản tham chiếu, 2035: lượng đạm cung ứng và lượng đạm thịt được thay thế
value: about 19,000 t delivered; about 2,350 t (0.2%) displaced
context: Demand model (demand_outputs.csv), scenario D-BENCH. Most delivered protein replaces imported ingredients; about 11,000 to 17,000 t of it would be made in Vietnam (v0.4 reading: only import substitution applies an explicit domestic share). Displacement falls to about 2,290 t if school sales into the plant-protein slot displace tofu, not meat. The Part IV S-ALT scenario assumes 39,300 t (3%) displaced in 2035. Our estimate, not a forecast.

label: What S-ALT 2030 would need from hybrids alone
label_vi: Điều kiện để đạt S-ALT năm 2030 chỉ bằng sản phẩm thịt pha trộn
value: 74% of all processed meat, with 30% of its meat replaced
context: Alternatives: 39% of all canteen and school meal protein; about 131 million regular analogue buyers; or about 0.43 extra chay days per person per month. Our estimate (demand model, demand_outputs.csv).

label: Actor questions that Part III (v0.3) answered in full
label_vi: Số câu hỏi của các bên liên quan được Phần III (phiên bản 0.3) trả lời đầy đủ
context: 80 named actors in four groups; Part III partly answered 71 questions and did not answer 42; 4 were out of scope. Our assessment (actor_questions.csv; ch29-actor-check).

label: School lunch days with any plant protein in a protein dish
label_vi: Tỷ lệ ngày ăn bán trú có đạm thực vật trong món đạm
context: 48 published school-weeks from 22 primary schools in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi and Hai Phong; only 9 of 48 weeks met the twice-weekly plant-protein rule of Decision 3958/QĐ-BYT; no dish used textured soy or mock meat.

label: Animal-protein standard printed by the school menu software
label_vi: Chuẩn đạm động vật in trong phần mềm xây dựng thực đơn bán trú
context: Printed on nutrition sheets from the MOET, Ajinomoto and NIN menu software; national guidance (Decision 3958/QĐ-BYT) sets no animal share. 9 of 25 published days fell below it.

label: Upland boarding-school main meals with a meat, fish or egg dish
label_vi: Tỷ lệ bữa chính có thịt, cá hoặc trứng ở trường phổ thông dân tộc bán trú
context: Our coding of published menus (upland_school_weeks.csv): 13 ethnic-minority boarding schools in five provinces, 22 published school-weeks; pork was in 102 of 124 lunches (82%); 86% of breakfasts had little or no animal food.

label: Protein dishes on factory caterers' menus, by lead protein
label_vi: Cơ cấu món đạm trong thực đơn suất ăn công nghiệp
context: Five caterers' published sample menus; minced or processed meat 17% of protein dishes; plant-only dishes 3%; no textured soy or mock meat named.

label: Import duty on Chinese textured protein, isolates and gluten
label_vi: Thuế nhập khẩu đạm tạo cấu trúc, đạm phân lập và gluten từ Trung Quốc
context: HS 2106.10, 3504 and 1109 enter at 0% from China, ASEAN and Korea with a certificate of origin; the MFN rates of 5%, 3% and 10% apply only to other origins. A domestic maker has no tariff shelter.

label: Excise on drinks above 5 g sugar per 100 ml
label_vi: Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt với đồ uống trên 5 g đường/100 ml
context: Law 66/2025/QH15; dairy is exempt; whether sweetened soy, nut and oat milks are in scope is unresolved; core Fami soy milks carry 6.5 to 9.3 g sugar per 100 ml.

label: Animals spared a year by the displacing routes, benchmark path (2035)
label_vi: Số con vật tránh được mỗi năm theo kịch bản tham chiếu (2035)
context: D-BENCH; 93 to 94% chickens and ducks; import substitution spares none. The range reflects the caterer and national meat mixes. Our estimate, not a forecast.

label: CO2e avoided a year by the displacing routes, benchmark path (2035)
label_vi: Lượng CO2e tránh được mỗi năm theo kịch bản tham chiếu (2035)
context: D-BENCH, net of the replacing protein; about half from displacing beef and buffalo. Treat climate as a co-benefit. Our estimate, not a forecast.

label: Original demand moves with a funder whose scope fits and that accepts Vietnam
label_vi: Số biện pháp phía cầu ban đầu có nhà tài trợ phù hợp và phạm vi tài trợ gồm cả Việt Nam
context: Our coding of funder scopes (funder_fit.csv). Consumer-acceptance studies and a label test are judged to fit the Bezos Centre at NUS; naming and novel-food rules fit Nova Vista. Diet-change and culture-change work is excluded by Nova Vista and ACE Movement Grants; ReRoot Asia has no Vietnam track. Of the two moves added in v0.4, DMV-20 has no external payer and DMV-21 needs none.

label: Installed cost of a Chinese-equipped dry textured-soy line
label_vi: Chi phí lắp đặt dây chuyền đạm đậu tương tạo cấu trúc dạng khô thiết bị Trung Quốc
context: Chinese lines of 0.2 to 1.5 t/h with dryer list at USD 11,000 to 100,000 (list prices, not quotes). Installed cost allows up to three times the list price plus auxiliaries, fit-out, certification and a 15% contingency. Working capital of 3 to 4 months of revenue at price parity, USD 0.6 to 3.5 million, is the larger need. Our calculation.

label: Delivered soy-flour price above which a 1 t/h textured-soy line earns less than 15% at Chinese parity
label_vi: Giá bột đậu tương giao tận nơi mà trên mức đó dây chuyền đạm tạo cấu trúc 1 tấn/giờ không còn đạt biên lợi nhuận 15% khi bán ngang giá hàng Trung Quốc
unit: USD per t of food-grade defatted soy flour
context: For a 15% margin at Chinese landed parity at 0% duty (USD 1.29 per kg) on a 1 t/h line at 70% utilisation; about USD 700 per t with heavy overheads and about USD 940 per t when run lean. Flour is 63 to 85% of cost. Our calculation.

label: Vietnamese meat-analogue startups still active
label_vi: Số công ty khởi nghiệp thịt thực vật Việt Nam còn hoạt động
context: From our firm register (firm_outcomes.csv): all three Vietnamese makers of traditional formats are active. Of 24 regional and Vietnamese firms since 2019, 7 are active, 4 pivoted (all towards private label, co-manufacturing, a retail blend or non-food), 2 exited and 11 are dormant. One dormant firm (Bien Phuong) has an unknown first channel, so the channel rows in Appendix D4 sum to 23 firms and 10 dormant.

label: Adults who ate no meat, poultry or fish on the previous day (2021)
label_vi: Tỷ lệ người trưởng thành không ăn thịt, gia cầm, cá trong ngày hôm trước (2021)
context: Global Diet Quality Project, Gallup, 1,007 adults; a ceiling for chay-day person-days that supports the 2.5% central estimate and caps the upper bound near 5%. 40% ate beans, tofu or soy milk.

label: Protein content needed for a high-protein claim
label_vi: Hàm lượng đạm để được công bố "cao đạm"
unit: g protein per 100 g of solid food
context: TCVN 14429:2025 (voluntary, Codex-based): source at 5 g and high at 10 g per 100 g, or 2.5 g and 5 g per 100 kcal. 20 of 43 audited foods already meet the source condition per 100 g (27 by either route); none makes the claim.

label: Inactive yeast imported for food and feed (HS 2102.20)
label_vi: Lượng nấm men bất hoạt nhập khẩu (HS 2102.20)
value: 9,193 t (USD 13.5 million); 95% at about USD 1.1 per kg
context: Partners reported exporting 9,193 t to Vietnam in 2025 (mirror data, incomplete; 2024: 9,336 t). 8,729 t (95%) came in at below USD 2 per kg, averaging USD 1.10 per kg FOB; 464 t of specialty products averaged USD 8.55. 2.4 times the 2019 tonnage; the trade code does not separate feed from food. The revealed price a Vietnamese microbial feed ingredient must beat. Partners also reported importing 8,166 t from Vietnam in 2025.

label: Vietnam's exports of dumplings and other stuffed pasta
label_vi: Kim ngạch xuất khẩu há cảo và các loại mì nhồi nhân
context: HS 1902.20, 30,013 t; the existing export base for plant-protein wrapped foods. In 2025, Vietnam out-supplied China in the UK, US and Korea (partner import data).

label: Processor saving from replacing 20% of lean with textured soy in chả lụa
label_vi: Mức tiết kiệm khi thay 20% thịt nạc bằng đạm đậu tương trong chả lụa
context: Extension pays at every annual hog price from 2019 to 2024; hydrated soy costs a sixth to a twelfth of lean trimmings. A new extender must beat soy, not meat. Our calculation: soy hydrated to 18% protein, lean priced at 1.8 times the live hog price, and the 2025 landed Chinese textured-soy price applied to 2019 to 2020 hog prices.

label: Confirmed meat-in-chay cases found in our search
label_vi: Số vụ phát hiện thịt trong đồ chay đã được xác nhận, theo tìm kiếm của chúng tôi
context: One unconfirmed 2021 seizure in An Giang; chay safety cases are about borax, microbes and unlabelled goods. Fake chay is a latent rumour, not a live scandal.

label: Share of the world's soy fed to livestock
label_vi: Tỷ lệ đậu nành thế giới dùng làm thức ăn chăn nuôi
context: About 6% of soy is eaten directly as food; 87% of soybeans are crushed and 99% of the meal goes to feed (2018; USDA data via Our World in Data and Fraanje and Garnett 2020).

label: Livestock's share of human-caused greenhouse gas emissions
label_vi: Tỷ trọng phát thải khí nhà kính do chăn nuôi
context: 6.2 Gt CO2e for 2015 in FAO's latest estimate; 7.1 Gt for 2005 in its earlier one. The two use different reference years, so the lower figure is not evidence that emissions fell. Food systems as a whole: about 34% (2015).

label: Land animals slaughtered for meat worldwide
label_vi: Số động vật trên cạn bị giết mổ lấy thịt trên thế giới
context: 91% chickens; about 1.5 billion pigs and 305 million cattle. Our sum of FAOSTAT counts for seven species, so a floor. Fish estimates run into the trillions and are highly uncertain.

label: Global investment in alternative protein companies
label_vi: Vốn đầu tư toàn cầu vào doanh nghiệp protein thay thế
context: Of this, USD 734 million was private and USD 147 million was raised by publicly traded companies. The first year below USD 1 billion since 2018; the 2021 peak was about USD 7 billion in GFI's current series. USD 359 million in the first half of 2026, 252 million of it for fermentation. GFI (advocacy) analysis of Net Zero Insights data.
